faq.q: What kind of companies do you work with?
faq.a: Mostly SMBs and mid-market companies (10 to 250 people) in Spain, Latin America and the United States, plus startups, software companies and fintechs.

faq.q: Do you work alone or with a team?
faq.a: I lead every project personally and work with a development and automation team for execution, so you get a single point of contact and real delivery capacity.

faq.q: How much does a project cost?
faq.a: It depends on scope. After the free discovery call you get a fixed proposal. Many clients start with an audit or a short sprint to get quick, low-risk results.
Yes. I'm based in Barcelona and work remotely with clients worldwide, in English and Spanish.
